name: trill-tuner
description: Trill Tuner — a complete guitar companion: from-scratch YIN tuner with strobe + poly strum check, 94 tunings, metronome with jam tracks, recorder, single-field lyric search (artist OR title), a 600+ song play-along library plus built-in lyrics, a tab maker that listens to any song and tells you the chords, key, tempo and capo to play it, a stem lab that removes or isolates the vocals, drums, bass, electric and acoustic guitar of a track (including an acoustic-only chop that leaves the electric and the kit playing), a backing-track studio that generates practice beds in any key and feel, a live accuracy listener that names every wrong note and confirms every right one, a player & style explorer, my-stuff favourites with a session builder, a learning academy, practice studio, advanced toolkit, virtual amplifier + pedalboard (70 amps, 145 pedals, 41 famous rigs), progress sharing, backups and guitar care.
